records.label: spacr.point_spread#1
records.source: Calculated kernels are sampled Gaussian approximations with explicitly supplied FWHM and pixel/voxel spacing, not estimates of a microscope's optical PSF. Measured kernels retain their supplied centre pixel as the optical origin. Processing uses half-sample symmetric boundaries, independently per channel. Richardson–Lucy uses the transpose of that same boundary operator, including its sensitivity normalization for asymmetric kernels. More iterations may amplify noise; this is not a claim of recovered biological structure.
records.context: Calculated kernels are sampled Gaussian approximations with explicitly supplied FWHM and pixel/voxel spacing, not estimates of a microscope's optical PSF. Measured kernels retain their supplied centre pixel as the optical origin. Processing uses half-sample symmetric boundaries, independently per image data channel. Richardson–Lucy uses the transpose of that same boundary operator, including its sensitivity normalization for asymmetric kernels. More iterations may amplify noise; this is not a claim of recovered biological structure.
records.translation: Berechnete Kernel sind abgetastete Gauß-Näherungen mit explizit angegebener FWHM und explizit angegebenem Pixel-/Voxelabstand, keine Schätzungen der optischen PSF eines Mikroskops. Gemessene Kernel behalten ihr angegebenes Mittelpixel als optischen Ursprung. Die Verarbeitung verwendet halbsample-symmetrische Ränder, unabhängig für jeden Kanal. Richardson–Lucy verwendet die Transponierte desselben Randoperators, einschließlich seiner Empfindlichkeitsnormalisierung für asymmetrische Kernel. Mehr Iterationen können Rauschen verstärken; das ist keine Behauptung, biologische Struktur wiederhergestellt zu haben.
